text:
alex: quick heads-up — canary shows steady memory growth during mixed streaming-chat + tool-loop runs. sessions end but RSS barely drops.

alex: repro is a 2h run: alternating long-context streaming chat (~8k tokens) and short tool loops. after ~30-40 cycles RSS climbs ~600MB.

maria: do you have jemalloc stats or pmap?

alex: pasted snapshot from the canary at ~2h:

```
# pmap -x 23145 | tail -n 5
23145:   1200M total,  540M anon,  640M file,  20M shmem
heap: 1.1G resident
stack: 8M
anonymous mappings: many 64k and 2M holes
```

alex: jemalloc admin stats (abridged):
```
allocated: 1.26G
active: 1.62G
mapped: 1.90G
metadata: 210M
retained: 280M
fragmentation_ratio = active/allocated = 1.28
```

tariq: kv cache metrics? are we not evicting pages?

alex: kv_cache_pages: 582 -> 820 during the run. evictions/sec ~0.8 (expected ~5). page reuse drops after long-context events.

alex: stack trace from profiler when memory was high (top alloc sites):
```
0  runtime::kv_insert_or_pin
1  kv_cache::allocate_page
2  runtime::streaming_chunk_handler
3  toolloop::call_external
```

devon: hmm looks like high allocation rate but low eviction. could be compaction/backfill paused. any recent kernel-selection or batching changes on this canary?

alex: yes — we recently enabled 'aggressive-batching' (heuristic v3) which batches more tokens for short calls. suspicion: it increases KV residency time for pages that are then referenced by long streaming sessions, preventing eviction windows.

maria: also noticed compactor runs are gated by short_session_ratio < 0.2 in config. if aggressive-batching increases short sessions we might be never hitting compaction window. config snippet:
```
"kv_compaction": {
  "short_session_ratio_threshold": 0.2,
  "min_idle_ms": 60000
}
```

tariq: can we force a compaction in the repro to see if RSS drops?

alex: did manual run: POST /admin/kv/compact?level=full -> RSS dropped ~220MB immediately, and fragmentation ratio improved to 1.12. but growth resumed after another 10 cycles.

devon: so compaction helps but doesn't stop re-growth. hypothesis: fragmentation + page-scarcity causing allocator to map new regions instead of reusing freed pages. Could be jemalloc arena leakage under thread churn.

maria: next steps: 1) capture per-arena stats during run 2) enable jemalloc background purging (was off on canary) 3) add an eviction pressure probe to force higher eviction rate and measure latency impact.

alex: I already ran per-arena snapshot; sending gist later. quick mitigation: roll back heuristic v3 on canary + enable jemalloc background purging.

sre-bot: incident created INC-2026-45, assignees: @alex @maria. ETA 4h for mitigation verification. :white_check_mark:

tariq: also add a small test that alternates short/long sessions for 2h in CI to catch regressions. simple repro command: `./testbench --mix short:1s long:480s --cycles 100`

devon: for long-term fix we should consider: 1) make compactor trigger aware of kv page reference heat (not just short_session_ratio) 2) tune batching heuristic to prefer evictable layouts 3) explore jemalloc arena reuse flags.

alex: agreed. I'll collect heap profiles + arena dumps and post them. updating the incident with findings shortly.

maria: ping if you want help correlating kv page telemetry with jemalloc arenas. I can wire a small exporter.

alex: thanks — will loop you in.

sre-bot: reminder scheduled: canary rollback job queued for heuristic v3 at 1951246800 if no green signal.
